class Doctor:

        self.work_hours = work_hours  # total relevant clinical hours

class MedicalCase:
    def __init__(self, case_id, specialty, complexity):
        self.case_id = case_id
        self.specialty = specialty
        self.complexity = complexity  # e.g., 1 (simple) to 5 (most complex)

def assign_cases(doctors, cases):
    # Sort doctors by work hours (descending) — more hours = more experienced
    sorted_doctors = sorted(doctors, key=lambda d: d.work_hours, reverse=True)
    # Sort cases by complexity (descending) — most complex first
    sorted_cases = sorted(cases, key=lambda c: c.complexity, reverse=True)

    assignments = {}
    for case in sorted_cases:
        # Find the most experienced doctor in the matching specialty
        for doctor in sorted_doctors:
            if doctor.specialty == case.specialty:
                if doctor.name not in assignments:
                    assignments[doctor.name] = []
                assignments[doctor.name].append(case.case_id)
                break  # Assign to the top available doctor

    return assignments

# Example usage

]

]
